financial_frequency: Original FY2015-FY2025 annual earnings releases; annual-only pilot
financial_availability: Use a release only on a trading date strictly after its publication date; execute signals at the following tradable open
review_frequency: First data trading day of each calendar month, including initial test date
growth_definition: 12.5 * clip(revenue YoY percent / 25, 0, 1) + 12.5 * clip(non-IFRS attributable profit YoY percent / 25, 0, 1); use growth as disclosed in that release
valuation_definition: 25 * clip((50 - PE) / 30, 0, 1); PE = unadjusted HKD close * prior-date CNY per HKD / latest disclosed annual non-IFRS diluted EPS in CNY; no forward estimates or current snapshot ratios
safety_definition: 10 * clip((net cash / annual non-IFRS attributable profit + 1) / 2, 0, 1); net debt is negative net cash
shareholder_definition: 10 * clip(announced ordinary final DPS YoY percent / 20, 0, 1); proposed ordinary cash dividends only, exclude special distributions and future repurchase plans
freshness: Financial release maximum age 400 calendar days; missing/stale data forces flat on monthly review; FX strictly prior date and at most 7 calendar days old
technical_rule: Adjusted close strictly above trailing 200-bar SMA, including current close; tactical sleeve held only when fundamental eligibility is true and trend is positive, reviewed monthly
warmup: Use only the frozen 2461 stock bars; tactical sleeve cash until 200 bars are present; explicitly matched trend control uses same warmup
hybrid: Independent 70% fundamental sleeve plus 30% fundamental-and-SMA200 sleeve; no transfers or rebalancing between sleeves
controls: 70% Buy & Hold plus 30% SMA200-only, with same review frequency and warmup
execution: Existing Rust adjusted synthetic fractional-unit backtest engine; next positive-volume open; terminal liquidation; no cash interest
reason_for_reduced_inputs: Small verifiable pilot using consistently available original annual-release fields; free vendor snapshots were found to mix current quote/dividend fields into historical rows
validation: Check source provenance, announcement timing, currency and adjusted/raw separation, prefix invariance, monthly state transitions, sleeves and engine fills; compare all fixed variants without selecting a winning parameter set
